lines.zh: 一步一晃，我走在队伍里。
lines.en: Waddling step by step, I keep in the line.

lines.zh: 拍不动翅膀，我只好快走。
lines.en: My wings won't lift me, so I walk fast.

lines.zh: 成群的渡渡鸟，把路堵住了。
lines.en: The dodo flock has plugged the path.

lines.zh: 我一步一点头，像在数地。
lines.en: Each step bobs my head, as if counting the ground.

lines.zh: 雄的走在前面，个子大半圈。
lines.en: The males lead, a size larger than the rest.

lines.zh: 我尾巴上的羽毛一翘一翘。
lines.en: My tail feathers bob up and down.
The grass is full of my footprints.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀拍不动，只好快走。
lines.en: My wings will not beat, so I walk fast.
The line breaks up and I catch up again.

lines.zh: 我用笨重的脚碾过落叶。
lines.en: My heavy feet crush the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我跟着叫。
lines.en: A flock-mate calls and I call back.
These wings of mine are good only for fanning.

lines.zh: 我低头看路，脖子往前顶。
lines.en: I watch the ground, neck pushed forward.

lines.zh: 绕过那棵树，我差点栽倒。
lines.en: Rounding that tree, I nearly topple over.

lines.zh: 我们一群，把草吃得只剩根。
lines.en: Our flock grazes the grass down to the roots.
I wobble my way through the bushes.
Walking this fast has ruffled my feathers.

lines.zh: 前面有虫，我加快了两步。
lines.en: Bugs ahead. I hurry two steps.
I don't fly; the ground is my home.
The one at the back of the line is me.

lines.zh: 我站着打盹，头一点一点。
lines.en: I doze on my feet, head nodding.

lines.zh: 嗓子发干，我吞了口空气。
lines.en: My throat is dry; I swallow some air.
I tilt my head at a butterfly.
I peck the ground and flick up a bit of soil.

lines.zh: 群里有谁在叫，我懒得应。
lines.en: Someone in the flock calls; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 这几根尾羽，我整理了半天。
lines.en: I've been preening these tail feathers forever.
I hold my beak open to cool off.
I lean to one side, none too steady.
Grass seed is stuck to my beak.
I stand still as a haystack.
Noise far off. I don't care.

lines.zh: 我这笨身子，走起来摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: This clumsy body waddles when it walks.
I peck once at your shoelace.
I'm not afraid of people. Never have been.

lines.zh: 你的鞋比我的脚大好多。
lines.en: Your shoe is much bigger than my foot.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子仰得酸。
lines.en: I look up at you until my neck aches.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，闻你的指缝
lines.en: I stretch my neck to sniff between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我就站在你脚边，不走了。
lines.en: I'll stand at your feet and go no further.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我退了一步
lines.en: When you laugh, I take a step back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在头的两边。
lines.en: My eyes sit on either side of my head.
You reach out; I don't flinch.
I blink and tilt my head.
The pain spins me in place.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一地，渡渡鸟太笨。
lines.en: Feathers everywhere; this dodo is clumsy.
I coo and hide in the flock.
Don't hit me. I'm this small.
One of my legs is lame now.
That one dazed me.
I crouch and ball myself up.
My wing hangs; I can't lift it.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，挡在我前面。
lines.en: The flock gathers and stands in front of me.
The pain passes. I'm still standing.
Fruit. I see it.
Whatever you scatter, I'll eat it all.
I'm running now, wobbling badly.
The flock is coming too; I'd better hurry.
That smell is sweet enough to sour.
Don't throw it far; my legs are short.
I swallow it whole without chewing.
Is there more? I'm not full.
I follow your hand.
For that, I'd walk a long way.
I bounce off you before you even move.
That knocked my feathers out of place.
I squawk once and shuffle aside.
Too hard. You're not grass.
A flock-mate crashed into me too.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一堆，谁也走不动。
lines.en: We're bunched up and nobody can move.
My feet slipped and I sat down.
I shake my head after the bump. Fine.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽被你踩得翘起
lines.en: You have stepped my tail feathers askew.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地挤过你脚边
lines.en: I waddle past your feet.
I bump headfirst into a flock-mate.

lines.zh: 绒毛和绒毛撞在一起，没事。
lines.en: Down meets down. No harm done.
That male holds his neck straight up.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理它的颈羽
lines.en: I preen the feathers on its neck with my beak.

lines.zh: 我们互相点头，像在讲和。
lines.en: We nod at each other, as if making peace.

lines.zh: 它比我大一圈，走路更晃。
lines.en: He's a size bigger and wobbles more.

lines.zh: 草窝就在那边的矮树下面。
lines.en: The nest is under the low bush over there.
I carry dry grass over, one stem at a time.
The egg goes on the ground. Just one.
We take turns sitting on the nest.
He keeps watch and I rest easier.

lines.zh: 等小的出来，队伍又要挤了。
lines.en: When the chick hatches the line gets crowded again.
I peck up a seed and tip my head back to swallow.
Whatever falls to the ground is ours.
I carry the fruit off half a lap.

lines.zh: 虫子还在动，我啄了两下。
lines.en: The bug is still moving, so I peck it twice.
That bite was too small to count.
I let the little one have the big piece.
My throat bulges, and I still peck for more.
I hold on tight while a flock-mate tugs.

lines.zh: 我把它踩在脚下，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I pin it under my foot and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 吃完我抹了抹嘴在草上。
lines.en: Afterward I wipe my beak on the grass.
Something is crawling in the mud over there.
I've spotted it. A worm.
I turn my head and use one eye.
It's close; a few steps will do.
The flock hasn't noticed. I'll go first.
I stretch my neck out and lean in.
It's moving. It's edible.

lines.zh: 我脖子前伸，盯着那条虫
lines.en: I stretch my neck and fix on that worm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，怕惊了它。
lines.en: I edge over, afraid to startle it.
It's right at my beak now.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，一小步一小步。
lines.en: I follow it in tiny steps.
It slips into the grass; I peck the grass.

lines.zh: 我的头一点一点，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My head bobs as if keeping time.
It stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估量它的位置。
lines.en: I tilt my head to judge where it is.
A little closer and I'll strike down.

lines.zh: 同伴也围过来了，得快点。
lines.en: The flock is closing in too; I must be quick.
It tries to flee; I block it with a wing.
I put a foot on its tail.
Now it can't get away.
I peck and hit nothing.
A clean peck. I've got it.
I flap a wing and knock it aside.
I stamp with my foot, harder than I look.
It scratches me and I hop back.

lines.zh: 我啄了它两下，它不动了。
lines.en: Two pecks and it stops moving.
I charge and fall over first.
That peck is heavier than it looks.
I pick it up and shake it twice.
When it's over I ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 我们排着队，一摇一摆走。
lines.en: We waddle along in a line.
A flock of my kind is waiting for me.
The grass on this island is soft.
I flap my wings. I can't fly.
A place with no predators. How good.
I tilt my head and study the ground.
My call doesn't carry far.
Mud underfoot, grass at my beak.
I shake off a coat of down.
Someone is watching me from a distance.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，脖子咔一声。
lines.en: I stretch, and my neck clicks.
This flock starts today.
My feathers smoke and I run blindly.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，摔得晕头转向。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my head spins.
Water pours into my beak and I thrash.
A bang flips me over.
These stubby wings don't stop arrows.
A numbness spreads over me and I can't walk.

lines.zh: 草籽都没了，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: No seeds left; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的绒毛全竖着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my down stands on end.
I fall, and my wings are useless.
